arc.title: O Frio Sob a Pedra
arc.description: Uma ferramenta coberta de geada leva a Casa a solicitar uma vistoria na cava pública. Enquanto a equipe mede o risco sem saber o que há sob a pedra, Nima decide atravessar a estrada para rever Ilyan.

pages.title: O desenho no caderno
pages.layout: wide archive panel, diagram inset and locked-cabinet inset
pages.scene: At the Four Moons archive, Runa and Ilyan examine Mira's quarry ventilation diagram; her authenticated page remains locked in Ordelia's cabinet.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Mira desenhou um conduto sob a cava pública.

pages.narration: O traço antigo não indicava uma entrada para o Entremeio nem o paradeiro de Mira.

pages.title: Geada em dia quente
pages.layout: quarry establishing panel, iron plate close-up, written measurement
pages.scene: Hessa presents a cold iron plate removed from the public quarry to Eda, who records the anomaly without naming a creature.

pages.title: Contar as fontes
pages.layout: wide classroom demonstration over water, sand and charcoal details
pages.scene: Oru teaches the students to count actual water, sand, fuel and moving air before applying magic in the unchanged Hall of Elements.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Antes do feitiço, contem a fonte. E o custo.

pages.title: A pena do meio
pages.layout: courtyard wide panel and close-up of three feather stakes
pages.scene: Sere guides Caio through existing wind past three feather markers; he moves the middle feather but scatters leaves on the next attempt.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Use o vento que já existe.

pages.title: Dois batimentos
pages.layout: strength exercise panel followed by safe lowering and shoulder recovery
pages.scene: Tovo amplifies his strength for two beats, lowers the training stone and rubs his shoulder under Oru's supervision.

pages.title: Estações separadas
pages.layout: split laboratory composition with water and fracture detail
pages.scene: Runa precisely guides water from an existing basin while Líria finds a hidden fracture by touching dry stone; they work at separate benches and remain bitter rivals.

pages.title: A carta de Ilyan
pages.layout: warm forge panel, unfolded letter detail, quiet father-friend conversation
pages.scene: Nima receives Ilyan's ordinary letter at Bram's forge in Pedra-Mansa; it says they found proof Mira lived after leaving, without protected-route details.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Ele encontrou uma prova de Mira... e escreveu para mim.

pages.narration: A carta não mudava a resposta honesta que ele lhe dera antes. A saudade continuava.

pages.title: Uma escolha sua
pages.layout: forge doorway panel, fare ledger detail and wagon outside
pages.scene: Nima tells Bram she has paid her own passage to Valecobre and wants to see Ilyan; Bram helps check the wagon axle without trying to decide for her.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Comprei a passagem. Quero vê-lo pessoalmente.

pages.title: A licença antiga não basta
pages.time: Dia 538 · fim da tarde, em Valecobre
pages.layout: planning table panel with public-map detail and petition ledger
pages.scene: Eda files a request for an exterior survey of the public quarry; Ordelia verifies that the old road-and-quay permission does not include a pit on the slope.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: A licença não inclui a cava.

pages.title: Sem forçar a pedra
pages.layout: school briefing panel, boundary map inset and Ilyan listening
pages.scene: Ordelia tells Ilyan that any survey will stay on the public bank and leave the protected seam shut; Runa keeps Mira's diagram on the desk.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: A costura segue fechada. Só a cava pública pode ser vistoriada.
